verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships its own mock servers, both cloud-hosted and self-hosted via Mockbin. Mocks can be AI-generated from a prompt, an OpenAPI spec, or a live URL response, and dynamic mocking adds request-aware fake data, giving users a sandbox to test against instead of production. Global, collection, and folder environments let users swap base URLs and credentials so the same requests target non-production targets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing mocks and environments as production-isolation safeguards (e.g., guardrails against accidentally hitting prod), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox testing workflows.
